prompt: In many growing cities, most new homes are now built as flats in high-rise tower blocks rather than as individual houses with gardens. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Nowadays in many big cities, the most of new homes are built as flats in tall buildings instead of houses with a garden. Some people think this is a good trend, while other people believe it has many problems. In my opinion, the advantages of this trend are more than the disadvantages.

The first advantage is that tall buildings save a lot of land. In the big cities the land is very expensive and there is not enough space for everyone, so building upward is the only solution. If a city build houses instead, it will spread into the countryside and people will need to travel long distance to their work. Another advantage is that flats are cheaper than houses, so more young people can buy their own home. Moreover, tall buildings usually have good facilities like lifts, security guards and parking, which makes the life more comfortable.

However, there are also some disadvantages. Firstly, living in a tall building is not suitable for the families with small children, because there is no garden and children cannot play outside safely. Secondly, people in the tower blocks often do not know their neighbours, so they feel lonely and there is no sense of community. Also, if the lift is broken, it is very difficult for old people to go up and down, and in case of fire it can be very dangerous for everybody.

In conclusion, although high-rise flats have some disadvantages such as loneliness and safety problem, I believe the advantages are more important, because the cities are growing very fast and there is no other way to give everybody a home. The government should make sure that the buildings are safe and have enough green spaces.
title: High-rise flats instead of family houses
